paragraphs.en: An open-source Android app to let you browse YouTube and other services freely.
paragraphs.zh: 一个开源 Android 应用，让你自由浏览 YouTube 及其他服务。

paragraphs.en: Due to differences in development philosophy, I forked NewPipe in early 2022 and began independent development based on it.
paragraphs.zh: 由于开发理念的分歧，我于2022年初 fork 了 NewPipe，并开始基于它进行独立开发。

paragraphs.en: This means that PipePipe neither receives updates from NewPipe nor pushes updates to NewPipe. They have become two separate projects. Issues that occur in NewPipe don't necessarily happen in PipePipe, and changes made in NewPipe may not be adopted by PipePipe. In contrast, forks like Tubular track the latest version of NewPipe and develop based on it.
paragraphs.zh: 这意味着 PipePipe 既不从 NewPipe 接收更新，也不向 NewPipe 推送更新。 它们已经成为两个独立的项目。 NewPipe 中出现的问题不一定会在 PipePipe 中发生，NewPipe 所做的更改也可能不会被 PipePipe 采用。 相比之下，像 Tubular 这样的分支会跟踪 NewPipe 的最新版本并基于它进行开发。

sents.en: This means that PipePipe neither receives updates from NewPipe nor pushes updates to NewPipe.
sents.zh: 这意味着 PipePipe 既不从 NewPipe 接收更新，也不向 NewPipe 推送更新。

sents.en: They have become two separate projects.
sents.zh: 它们已经成为两个独立的项目。

sents.en: Issues that occur in NewPipe don't necessarily happen in PipePipe, and changes made in NewPipe may not be adopted by PipePipe.
sents.zh: NewPipe 中出现的问题不一定会在 PipePipe 中发生，NewPipe 所做的更改也可能不会被 PipePipe 采用。

sents.en: In contrast, forks like Tubular track the latest version of NewPipe and develop based on it.
sents.zh: 相比之下，像 Tubular 这样的分支会跟踪 NewPipe 的最新版本并基于它进行开发。

paragraphs.en: Making a hard fork allows us to effectively address issues with quick fixes and maintain frequent feature updates.
paragraphs.zh: 进行硬分叉使我们能够通过快速修复有效解决问题，并保持频繁的功能更新。

paragraphs.en: PipePipe will ONLY use the login cookie for the specified scenarios you set. You can configure it in "Cookie Functions."
paragraphs.zh: PipePipe 仅会将登录 Cookie 用于你设置的指定场景。 你可以在「Cookie 功能」中进行配置。

sents.en: PipePipe will ONLY use the login cookie for the specified scenarios you set.
sents.zh: PipePipe 仅会将登录 Cookie 用于你设置的指定场景。

sents.en: You can configure it in "Cookie Functions."
sents.zh: 你可以在「Cookie 功能」中进行配置。

paragraphs.en: For YouTube, the cookie will only be used when retrieving playback streams.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 YouTube，Cookie 将仅用于获取播放流时使用。

paragraphs.en: Issues and PRs are welcomed. Please note that I will NOT accept service requests.
paragraphs.zh: 欢迎提交 Issue 和 PR。 请注意，我不会接受服务请求。

sents.zh: 欢迎提交 Issue 和 PR。

sents.en: Please note that I will NOT accept service requests.
sents.zh: 请注意，我不会接受服务请求。

paragraphs.en: Anyone interested in creating their own service is encouraged to fork this repository.
paragraphs.zh: 任何有兴趣创建自己服务的用户都欢迎 fork 此代码库。
